verdict.rationale: Unleash documents a gradual rollout strategy that releases a feature to a small subset of users first. Activation strategies change flag exposure without redeploying, and release management and impact metrics support percentage progression (e.g. 25% to 50%) with automated milestones and safeguards. missing for 10: explicit evidence of consistent/sticky bucketing (e.g. stickiness by user ID), explicit documentation of fine-grained 1%-to-100% ramping, independent or hands-on corroboration.
